title: Kjøttkaker med Fiskefrikadeller (German-Style Meatballs with Fish Patties)
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring Norwegian-style meatballs and fish patties, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine ground beef, ground pork, breadcrumbs, eggs, onion, allspice, salt, and black pepper. Mix well with your hands until just combined.
Use your hands to shape the mixture into meatballs, about 1 1/2 inches (3.8 cm) in diameter. Place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the meatballs in the preheated oven for 18-20 minutes, or until cooked through.
In a separate bowl, mix together flaked cod, panko breadcrumbs, and a pinch of salt and pepper.
Using your hands, shape the cod mixture into patties, about 1 inch (2.5 cm) thick.
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat. Add a small amount of oil and cook the fish patties for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Serve the meatballs and fish patties hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
